subject: KrakenTech RFP: control ownership & telemetry evidence clarification
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <procure@krakentech.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Omar Singh <devsecops@krakentech.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: KrakenTech RFP: follow-ups on SIG / SOC2 evidence

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — the KrakenTech procurement team is running a quick internal triage before we circulate the RFP to security. A few specific clarifications would help move us forward:

- In the SIG questionnaire you map several telemetry controls to "runtime monitoring". Can you point to example artifacts (log samples, retention policy excerpts) that demonstrate detection and alerting cadence for anomalous inference requests?
- For key management / rotation controls, Kraken needs a short summary of where KMS is hosted, rotation cadence, and a sample key rotation record or ticket.
- We're also trying to build a tentative mutual action plan: can Redwood provide a timeboxed window for artifact delivery and a preferred method (secure S3 share, pull-from-drive, or gated portal)?

Attached is our RFP cover (kraken-rfp-2027.pdf) with relevant timeline notes. If possible, can you respond by end of week with owners for each control area so we can align internal reviewers?

Thanks — Lena
Lena Ortiz
Sr. Procurement Manager, KrakenTech
procure@krakentech.com

Attachment: kraken-rfp-2027.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <procure@krakentech.com>
Cc: Omar Singh <devsecops@krakentech.com>, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KrakenTech RFP: follow-ups on SIG / SOC2 evidence

Lena — thanks for the clear asks. Quick plan and owners below so your reviewers know who to expect: 

- Telemetry / detection: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com) — will provide example log slices, alerting cadence, and the monitoring runbook excerpt.
- Key management & rotation: Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com) — will share KMS provider summary, rotation cadence, and a masked rotation ticket.
- SOC 2 / ISO summary: I'll attach the redacted SOC 2 report and a draft control mapping for SIG items so you can see the crosswalk.

Preferred delivery: secure S3 pre-signed links for log slices + a Drive folder for policy/attestation PDFs. If you prefer an upload to your portal, we can push to whatever system you use.

Tentative timeline: initial artifact bundle by 2027-11-20, follow-up deep-dive week of 2027-11-22 (can shift earlier if you need).

I attached a working draft of the control mapping to accelerate feedback. Kimberly / Neha — can you confirm the artifacts you plan to attach and whether any need SOC-team redaction?

Best,

Markus Klein
Sales Engineering Manager — Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: control_mapping_draft.xlsx (xlsx), redwood-soc2-report-2027.pdf (pdf)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com, Lena Ortiz <procure@krakentech.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, Omar Singh <devsecops@krakentech.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 14:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KrakenTech RFP: follow-ups on SIG / SOC2 evidence

Lena / team — following up with specifics on telemetry artifacts we can provide in the initial bundle: 

1) Telemetry sample (redacted): 
- File: telemetry-snapshot-20271120.log (attached as a redacted sample) — contains anonymized request IDs, timestamps, and alert flags.
- Retention policy excerpt: logs are retained 90 days hot, 24 months archived (we will include the policy doc excerpt).
2) Detection & alerting cadence: 
- Brief runbook excerpt describing anomaly thresholds (requests-per-second deviations, token-rate anomalies) and escalation SLA (15m for sev1).
- Example alert ticket: RDW-TR-2027-1120 (masked user info) showing triage to mitigation.
3) Access method:
- I'll upload a zipped sample to a time-limited S3 pre-signed URL and share it to the Drive folder you provided. If you want direct portal access (e.g., MFT link), let us know and we can arrange an SSO-enabled session.

Redactions: we will remove any PII and customer-specific IDs prior to delivery. If Kraken needs verifiable signed artifacts (e.g., an auditor-viewable SOC 2 package), we can arrange a scoped share with NDAs / auditor access.

Planned attachments for first bundle: telemetry-snapshot-20271120.log, monitoring_runbook_excerpt.pdf, masked-rotation-ticket.pdf (Neha will add).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stubs referenced: telemetry-snapshot-20271120.log (log), monitoring_runbook_excerpt.pdf (pdf)

From: Lena Ortiz <procure@krakentech.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Omar Singh <devsecops@krakentech.com>, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: KrakenTech RFP: follow-ups on SIG / SOC2 evidence

Thanks Markus / Kim / Neha — this is helpful and aligned with what our security reviewers asked for. A few quick items before you share the pre-signed links: 

- Can you confirm the exact S3 URL expiry window you plan to use (we prefer 72 hours for initial review)?
- For the masked rotation ticket, our security team will need an explanation of the ticket fields (a one-paragraph mapping is fine).
- Please include a contact for on-call escalation during our review (we may open a short troubleshooting call if artifacts trigger questions).

We can sign an NDA if that makes it easier to provide unredacted artifacts to the auditor later — the DocuSign link in related_links should work.

If you can deliver the initial bundle by EOD tomorrow, Kraken will schedule the security review for 2027-11-24. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lena
Sr. Procurement Manager, KrakenTech
procure@krakentech.com
